section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1983
title: 6 ## Causes of Accidental Deaths The total accidental deaths recorded during 1983 have been classified under two broad categories: (A) Accidental Deaths due to natural causes like lightning, heat strokes, floods, land slides, cold and exposure and cyclone and (B) Accidental deaths due to other causes like mishaps in factories, road accidents, air crashes, house collapse and boat capsizing etc. Category (A) accounted for 3·5 per cent of total accidental deaths recorded in 1983 in comparison to 3·6 per cent in 1982. Under this category, the maximum number of deaths in 1983 were due to 'Lightning' (1,884) followed by 'Floods' (849),
